**Key finding:** Megève has **no 2-star restaurants** — the topic title is a slight misnomer. The village has one 3-star table ([Flocons de Sel](https://www.floconsdesel.com/en/fine-dining/gourmet-table.html)) and two 1-star options ([Vous](https://www.juliengatillon.fr/en/vous-en/), La Table de l'Alpaga). For a June 2026 weekend, Flocons de Sel opens June 5 and Vous is open year-round; La Table de l'Alpaga is winter-only.
